name: musify
description: Musify - Modern Liquid Glass Web Music Player & PWA

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.deploy:appsail: npm run build:backend && catalyst deploy --only appsail
scripts.deploy:client: npm run build:frontend && catalyst deploy --only client
